description: STR-BYREF, DAO Field.Value put through a reference: W(ID LONG key, T TEXT(50), L LONG, D DOUBLE, B BINARY(8)). Row 1 puts by-reference variants (BSTR 'abc', I4 7, R8 2.5, a 3-byte odd BSTR 41 00 42); row 2 puts typed by-reference values (BSTR 'def', I4 8, R8 3.5, the same odd BSTR); row 3 puts a by-reference variant Null into T and Empty into L. Each field's Value is read back after the put and again after reopening. Asks whether a reference is dereferenced, how an odd BSTR travels through VT_BYREF|VT_BSTR, and what a referenced Null or Empty stores.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
